useCases.banjir.desc.message: Tropical cyclone Senyar brought heavy rainfall to Southeast Asia starting November 2025. Sentinel-1 radar imagery is used to detect flood inundation based on backscatter change between pre-flood and flood scenes.

useCases.banjir.imageAlt.message: Flood extent map for Cyclone Senyar affected area

useCases.garisPantai.desc.message: Annual coastline extraction from the Landsat archive since 1987 using INATIDES tidal modelling, to measure erosion and accretion rates along Indonesia's coastline.

useCases.garisPantai.imageAlt.message: Annual shorelines extracted from Landsat imagery — Java Island

useCases.padi.desc.message: Sentinel-2 data used to monitor annual rice growth via NDVI, LSWI, EVI, and NDRE indices, producing phenology maps, harvest estimates, and a monitoring dashboard for Telagasari.

useCases.padi.imageAlt.message: Rice planting monitoring dashboard for Telagasari

useCases.tambang.desc.message: Using the Bare Soil Index (BSI) method to compute the extent of the nickel mining area on Gag Island, Raja Ampat, based on bare-soil identification.

useCases.tambang.imageAlt.message: Nickel mining area map of Gag Island

useCases.mangrove.desc.message: Sentinel-2 data combined with a Random Forest classifier to delineate mangroves via spectral indices, with a case study south of Denpasar, Bali.

useCases.mangrove.imageAlt.message: Mangrove classification map south of Denpasar

useCases.pltp.desc.message: NDVI and Land Surface Temperature (LST) used to analyse surface temperature and geothermal plant activity, with a case study at Kamojang, West Java.

useCases.pltp.imageAlt.message: Land Surface Temperature map for Kamojang geothermal plant

homepage.faq.subtitle.message: Information regarding background, data access, and collaboration.

homepage.faq.q1.message: What is the background of PIKSEL formation?

homepage.faq.a1.message: PIKSEL was established through a strategic collaboration with Geoscience Australia, adopting Open Data Cube technology similar to the Digital Earth Australia platform. This initiative aims to build national geospatial data infrastructure independence to support more accurate decision making.

homepage.faq.q2.message: Is a user account required to access data?

homepage.faq.a2.message: No. Most data and API services (WMS/WCS) on piksel.id are open to the public without registration. Account registration is only required if you want to use the Jupyter Sandbox service for private data processing and simulation.

homepage.faq.a3.message: We welcome collaboration with academics, researchers, and other institutions. You can contribute by developing analysis modules in the Sandbox, or contact our team directly for potential broader geospatial product development cooperation.

homepage.faq.q4.message: What types and formats of data are available?

homepage.faq.a4.message: Currently we provide Analysis Ready Data from Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 constellations, and historical Landsat archives. Data is presented in Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) format to support fast and interoperable access.

homepage.faq.q5.message: How often is satellite data updated?

homepage.faq.a5.message: Our platform indexes new data daily. Satellites themselves pass over Indonesian territory every day but at different locations following their orbit paths. For a specific location, Sentinel-2 will return every 5 days and Sentinel-1 every 6-12 days.

useCases.agri.desc.message: Mendukung ketahanan pangan nasional melalui pemantauan fase tanam padi dan kesehatan lahan baku sawah. Menggunakan indeks vegetasi multitemporal untuk mengidentifikasi daerah sentra produksi, memantau pola tanam, dan mendukung estimasi luas panen di tingkat kabupaten.

useCases.urban.desc.message: Analisis tren perluasan area terbangun (urban sprawl) untuk mendukung perencanaan tata ruang wilayah. Memanfaatkan data arsip satelit jangka panjang untuk memantau konversi lahan di pinggiran kota dan mengukur laju pertumbuhan area terbangun antar periode sensus.

useCases.forestry.desc.message: Deteksi perubahan tutupan hutan secara berkala menggunakan kombinasi data optik dan radar. Identifikasi indikasi pembukaan lahan baru dan pantau pemulihan vegetasi melalui analisis time-series yang konsisten terhadap gangguan awan.

useCases.coastal.desc.message: Pantau perubahan garis pantai akibat abrasi dan akresi menggunakan data time-series Landsat sejak 1984. Identifikasi zona intertidal dan klasifikasi penutup lahan pesisir untuk mendukung pengelolaan wilayah pesisir terpadu.

useCases.disaster.desc.message: Pemanfaatan data radar Sentinel-1 untuk mendeteksi genangan banjir secara cepat, termasuk saat kondisi tertutup awan. Menyediakan peta indikatif area terdampak untuk mendukung respons kebencanaan dan perencanaan evakuasi.

useCases.mining.desc.message: Pantau pembukaan lahan untuk area tambang terbuka dan identifikasi perubahan bentang alam secara berkala. Kombinasi data optik dan radar untuk mendeteksi kolam tambang dan memantau progres rehabilitasi lahan pasca-tambang.
